summary: The three most noticeable problems are: (1) the skirt and petticoat retain a broad, rigid, bowl-like shape around the thighs in seated, crouched and raised-leg poses, especially sit_chair, cross_legged, jump_tuck, lie_back_elbows and sit_stand@36–60; (2) the knees lose some volume and form angular transitions in deep_lunge and the bent-leg phases of run; and (3) the large sleeves crowd together and lose a readable separation across the chest in arms_crossed and hug_self. These are minor at the supplied contact-sheet scale: much of the skirt behavior is expected with cloth physics disabled, and the images do not clearly establish deep body penetration, tearing or a broken joint. No major or broken deformation is clearly demonstrated. No obvious pop is visible between the supplied clip samples, although unsampled frames and playback timing cannot be assessed from these sheets.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Lap, skirt underside and front hem
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat hold a broad, rounded shell in front of the bent thighs instead of settling around the lap, an expected limitation of the disabled cloth physics without clearly demonstrated body penetration.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Skirt around the knees and folded lower legs
items.issue: The hem stays spread into a stiff bell around the folded legs instead of gathering against them or the implied floor, consistent with the absence of cloth simulation.

items.name: kneel_one
items.location: Raised thigh and surrounding skirt underside
items.issue: The raised thigh carries a large section of skirt and petticoat upward as one rigid flap, exposing an unusually broad underside rather than producing local folds.

items.name: cross_legged
items.location: Skirt and petticoat around the crossed shins
items.issue: The fabric forms a stiff basin with upright sides around the crossed legs rather than settling over them, although the visible leg overlaps do not establish a clear skin or cloth penetration.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Rear knee and skirt over the forward thigh
items.issue: The deeply bent rear knee has a slightly pinched, angular contour in the three-quarter view while the skirt lifts broadly over the forward thigh instead of folding locally.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Lifted thigh and front skirt hem
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat flare upward across a wider area than the lifted thigh would naturally displace, as expected to some degree without cloth physics.

items.name: run_r
items.location: Lifted thigh and front skirt hem
items.issue: The raised leg carries the front skirt into a broad, stiff flap rather than a localized fold, with no definite deep intersection visible.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.location: Skirt underside surrounding both tucked thighs
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat become an almost continuous raised dish around the tucked legs, a conspicuous lack of cloth folding attributable to the unsimulated chains.

items.name: high_kick
items.location: Skirt and petticoat around the kicking leg
items.issue: The kicking leg raises a large, stiff panel of skirt and petticoat with little local folding, but the shoe visible inside the open underside is not sufficient evidence that it penetrates the fabric.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.location: Sleeve overlap across the lower chest
items.issue: The inflated sleeves meet in a compressed central mass with little readable clearance or contact folding, making their overlap look mildly fused.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Sleeves across the chest and sternum
items.issue: The overlapping sleeves form a flattened, pointed mass across the chest instead of visibly compressing and folding around the crossed arms.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Skirt underside over the hips and extended thighs
items.issue: The skirt remains tented into a broad shell above the legs rather than settling over the thighs and implied support surface, consistent with disabled cloth physics.

items.name: run
items.location: Bent knees, especially in the three-quarter view
items.issue: The flexed knees show slightly pinched, angular transitions between thigh and calf, most visibly on the rear-folded leg at frame 32.

items.name: turn
items.issue: The crossing legs develop a narrow, slightly kinked knee-to-calf silhouette, although the front-view overlap alone does not establish that the legs pass through each other.

items.name: sit_stand
items.issue: During the seated phase the skirt and petticoat hold an inflated bowl around the thighs instead of settling over the lap, an expected cloth-physics limitation with no clear deep body penetration or sampled-frame pop.

items.name: spin
items.issue: The flared skirt and petticoat maintain an unusually uniform, rigid disk through the middle samples rather than showing flexible folds, consistent with the unsimulated cloth chains.

items.name: idol_dance
items.location: Front skirt and petticoat over the lifted thigh
items.issue: The lifted leg raises a broad, stiff section of skirt and petticoat rather than forming local folds, with no definite penetration or abrupt change demonstrated by these two samples.
